controles.affirmation: Contentieux Arm : appel d'Arm le 1er octobre 2025 devant la cour d'appel du 3e circuit, proces Qualcomm c. Arm le 5 octobre 2026, aucune provision comptabilisee, pertes « raisonnablement possibles » mais non probables
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T3 FY2026 (data-lake/QCOM/10Q/QCOM_2026-07-29.htm.gz), Commitments and Contingencies : « On September 30, 2025, the court entered a final judgment upholding the jury's verdict in favor of Qualcomm... On October 1, 2025, Arm filed a notice of appeal to the United States Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit. » ; « Trial is scheduled to begin on October 5, 2026. » ; « We have not recorded any accrual at June 28, 2026 for contingent losses associated with the matters described above based on our belief that losses, while reasonably possible, are not probable. » ; « The unfavorable resolution of one or more of these matters could have a material adverse effect on our business... »

controles.affirmation: Verbatim Apple : « we expect that Apple will increasingly use its own modem products... which will have a significant negative impact on our QCT revenues, results of operations and cash flows »
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T3 FY2026 : phrase reprise mot a mot, sans coupure ni ajout.

controles.affirmation: Licence d'exportation Huawei revoquee en mai 2024 par le departement du Commerce americain, plus aucun revenu produit attendu
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025 (QCOM_2025-11-05.htm.gz) : « in May 2024, the U.S. Department of Commerce revoked the export license under which we previously sold 4G and certain other integrated circuit products to Huawei... Accordingly, we do not expect to receive any further product revenues from Huawei ». Autosuffisance chinoise : « ...including due to pressure from or policies of the Chinese government (which has prioritized semiconductor self-sufficiency) ».

controles.affirmation: Chine (Hong Kong inclus) 20 340 M$ soit 46% des 44 284 M$ de ventes FY2025, contre 46% en 2024 et 37% en 2023
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025, Revenues by country : « China (including Hong Kong) $20,340 46% / $17,826 46% / $13,386 37% », total 44 284 M$.

controles.affirmation: Reprise de provision sur actifs d'impot differe de 5,7 Mds $ au T2 FY2026 et taux d'impot annuel attendu en produit de 40%
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T3 FY2026, Income Taxes : « we released our valuation allowance on our federal deferred tax assets resulting in a $5.7 billion income tax benefit in the second quarter of fiscal 2026 » ; « We estimate our annual effective income tax rate to be 40% benefit for fiscal 2026 ». Neuf mois : resultat avant impot 8 241 M$ contre 9 692 M$, resultat net 12 377 M$ contre 8 658 M$.

controles.affirmation: Chiffre spectaculaire 1 : resultat operationnel 1 626 M$ au T3 FY2026 contre 2 762 M$ (-41%), marge 16,3% contre 26,6%
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T3 FY2026, compte de resultat : « Total costs and expenses 8,321 7,603 ... Operating income 1,626 2,762 ». CA implicite 9 947 M$ et 10 365 M$ ; 1626/9947 = 16,3%, 2762/10365 = 26,6%. Calcul verifie.

controles.affirmation: Chiffre spectaculaire 2 : dette nette d'environ 6 966 M$ (liquidites et titres 8 304 M$ contre dette 15 270 M$), contre un ecart de 2 333 M$ neuf mois plus tot
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T3 FY2026, Liquidity : « Cash and cash equivalents $4,533 ... Marketable securities 3,771 ... $8,304 $12,478 $(4,174) Debt $15,270 $14,811 $459 ». 12 478 - 14 811 = -2 333.

controles.affirmation: Chiffre spectaculaire 3 : stocks 8 379 M$ au 28 juin 2026 contre 6 526 M$ au 28 septembre 2025 (+28%)
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T3 FY2026, bilan et note Composition of Certain Financial Statement Items : 8 379 et 6 526 presents. Ventes du trimestre 9 947 M$ et 11 271 M$ coherentes avec les ratios cites.
